ashley: Quick onboarding question 11 I got Vault access but not sure how to request limited read-only secrets for a PoC service. Should I request full secret names or an access path?
marco: Hi @ashley welcome! Request the exact Vault path(s) you need (e.g., secret/data/project/po c/stripe-readonly). Prefer path-scoped roles rather than listing all keys.
ashley: Cool. And for rotation/testing, can I ask for short TTL tokens?
marco: Yes. Put preferred TTL in the form (dev: 1h typical). We can issue a role with token_ttl=1h for PoCs.
ashley: Who approves this? I want to avoid hitting prod approvals if possible.
marco: For dev/stage only the project owner + devex is usually enough. Prod requires secops + owner.
devex-bot: Created SR-2026-1301 for ashley. Track: https://redwood-internal/requests/SR-2026-1301
secops: FYI: If you want to bind to an identity (OIDC/GitHub) say so in the request. We recommend identity binding even for PoCs to avoid shared tokens.
ashley: Thanks 11 adding the path and TTL now
